items.title: BioNTech (BNTX) Enters First Global Phase 3 Trial For New Breast Cancer Combo
items.summary: BioNTech (NasdaqGS:BNTX) and Gilead Sciences announced a clinical trial collaboration to test a novel first-line treatment approach in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer. The partnership centers on BioNTech’s bispecific immunomodulator pumitamig combined with a Gilead antibody-drug conjugate in a global Phase 3 study. items.title: GILD Q3 deep dive: HIV franchise drives growth as policy headwinds loom
items.summary: Biopharmaceutical company Gilead Sciences (NASDAQ:GILD) reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.8% year on year to $8.3 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $31.15 billion at the midpoint came in 1.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.55 per share was 16.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
